data.body: Classification: llm-behavioral. Root cause: commit 558475fed2 replaced correct 'Inline dispatch is mandatory — dso:* labels are agent file identifiers, NOT subagent_type values' with wrong 'Use the registered subagent_type directly — dso:code-reviewer-* are valid Agent tool subagent_type values'. Affected file: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md lines 231-234. The dispatch example at line 298 still correctly shows general-purpose + verbatim content, creating a direct contradiction.
